invariant: Same known failure class should fail fast before expensive qualification.

prevention: explicitly initialize newly added aggregate fields
CMake promotes supported missing-field initializer warnings to errors

classes.symptom: -Wrange-loop-construct copies std::string values in hot/evaluation loops
prevention: bind stable loop values by const reference
CMake promotes supported range-loop warnings to errors

classes.symptom: Lean ext tactic cannot prove Vec3 coordinate equality
prevention: register Vec3.ext_coords with @[ext]
keep exact geometry extensionality in the foundational Exact module

classes.symptom: positivity fails to establish nonnegativity of dot a a after unfolding
prevention: use explicit sq_nonneg hypotheses and nlinarith

classes.symptom: ssh -A railway.new does not expose forwarded agent inside Railway relay
prevention: perform deploy-key Git operations on dispatcher
send Railway source bundles without GitHub credentials

classes.symptom: Railway provisioning JSON can emit a one-time human_claim_url into Actions logs
prevention: filter human_claim_url lines in Railway SSH workflow output

classes.symptom: CACE OCI runner lacks CMake/Ninja but has persistent Lean infrastructure
prevention: treat CACE OCI as formal/static ARM64 lane
make C++ optional on that runner
use Avrea for C++/benchmarks

classes.symptom: self-hosted qualification job executes candidate code while holding repository write authority
prevention: self-hosted qualification job has contents: read only
checkout uses persist-credentials: false
result is uploaded as an artifact
separate GitHub-hosted publisher job holds contents: write and never executes candidate code

classes.symptom: A theorem that USES the current target is traversed backward and offered as proof evidence for its own prerequisite.
prevention: Treat USES and REQUIRES as directional proof-dependency edges.
Permit executable reuse only from theorem to prerequisite, never prerequisite to dependent.

classes.symptom: A validation or holdout theorem name/case ID is embedded in the base proof-search strategy list, making evaluation measure answer lookup rather than generalization.
prevention: Base proof-search tactics may reference reusable definitions but not validation/holdout case IDs.
Base proof-search tactics may not name the validation/holdout answer theorems.

classes.symptom: formal build keeps Mathlib pinned but silently adds or changes another Lake dependency
prevention: lock the complete Lake package graph by name/type/url/rev/inputRev
reject executable lakefile.lean
allow only reviewed Lean/Mathlib upstream repository prefixes

classes.symptom: A symlink in any parent component redirects key creation or access outside the intended protected directory.
prevention: Traverse parent components using directory file descriptors and O_NOFOLLOW/O_DIRECTORY.
Reject symlinked parent components before creating or reading signer material.

classes.symptom: A group/world-writable signer directory permits another principal to replace or inspect key material.
prevention: Require root/effective-user ownership for every parent component.
Reject writable non-sticky ancestors and require the final key directory to be private mode 0700.

classes.symptom: A private key with an unexpected hard link can be accessed or replaced through another filesystem name.
prevention: Require a regular file owned by the effective service user.
Require st_nlink == 1 before accepting an existing signer key.

classes.symptom: Concurrent key initializers can observe or publish a partially written key or diverging key identities.
prevention: Serialize initialization with an exclusive lock on the pinned key directory.
Publish a fully fsynced temporary key atomically without overwriting an existing key.

classes.symptom: An interrupted write can leave a partial key file or stale temporary material that is mistaken for the final signer key.
prevention: Write to a unique 0600 temporary file and fsync before atomic no-overwrite publication.
Remove temporary names on every exception path and fsync the parent directory.
